game.title: Tainted Grail: The Fall of Avalon

roadmap.title: Asylum Island: preserve the prologue items
roadmap.description: Keep an opening-cell save until you have the Old Letter and Ninian’s Tag. Before leaving the beach, kill Caradoc and take his Ranger armor; retain that beach save too.

roadmap.title: Horns of the South: start the long questlines
roadmap.description: Wear Caradoc’s armor for your first Act 1 conversation with him. Enter the fortress without opening its gate, and ask about Jann’s experimental potion on your first visit. Start Ughwe’s Stonewarden and Taranis’ Alchemist quests. Save before faction choices, support Breandan, and reload after the early Excalibur challenge.

roadmap.title: Cuanacht: finish local quests and preserve choices
roadmap.description: Deliver the prologue letter, continue the Stonewarden and Alchemist chains, and help the hospital and Children of Morrigan. Save before the sleeping Croakmaw and Sagremor decisions. Meet the chicken near the pig farmer.

roadmap.title: Forlorn Swords and the endings
roadmap.description: Secure every tribe’s attendance before taking the crown, and leave the crown area manually for the Moot. Meet the final chicken, finish the long questlines, and clear the hidden dungeons and five tombs. Retain a save outside Charred Conclave for the Life Spindle ending.

roadmap.title: Sanctuary of Sarras
roadmap.description: The paid expansion opens from an Act 2 or 3 bonfire through The Lost One’s quest. Gather the Organists and complete The Wandering Miracle. Kill and loot the Golden Floatling before the final decision, and keep a save before that decision because the ending closes Sarras.

achievements.description: Meet Arthur during the Asylum Island prologue.
achievements.summary: Meet Arthur during the Asylum Island prologue.

steps.text: Follow the prologue story until you meet @npc{Arthur}.

achievements.description: Extract Arthur’s soul fragment from Excalibur.
achievements.summary: Extract Arthur’s soul fragment from Excalibur.

steps.text: Finish @mechanic{A World to Win} and take the soul fragment from @item{Excalibur}.

achievements.description: Extract Arthur’s soul fragment from Palamedes’ shield.
achievements.summary: Extract Arthur’s soul fragment from Palamedes’ shield.

steps.text: Follow the Cuanacht main story to @item{Palamedes’ shield} and extract the fragment.

achievements.description: Extract Arthur’s soul fragment from his crown.
achievements.summary: Extract Arthur’s soul fragment from his crown.

steps.text: Follow the Forlorn Swords main story and extract the fragment from @item{Arthur’s Crown}.

achievements.description: Complete the main story of Avalon.
achievements.summary: Complete the main story of Avalon.

steps.text: Make a manual save outside @loc{Charred Conclave}, then finish the main story. Keep that save for the Life Spindle ending.

achievements.description: Choose the Life Spindle ending.
achievements.summary: Choose the Life Spindle ending.

steps.text: Save before each hidden dungeon and tomb. Keep a separate manual save outside @loc{Charred Conclave} for the final choice.

After Excalibur, visit the hidden door at Archspire and exhaust the Weaver’s dialogue. After Palamedes’ shield, visit the hidden door north of Cuanacht’s western lakes; defeat the Fore-Dweller Knight, touch the glowing stone, and finish the Weaver and Bleeding Heart conversations.
After those dungeons, enter the hidden door behind the Forlorn Swords waterfall north of the giant sword monument. Exhaust the Weaver’s dialogue, defeat him, and take the @item{Life Spindle}.
After every tomb, exhaust @npc{Fionola}’s dialogue outside. If she does not appear, finish the tomb’s remaining task or reload its saved game.

With Excalibur, clear the Tomb of Sir Lancelot on the southeastern coastal islet in Horns of the South. Speak to Lancelot, touch his sarcophagus, defeat the Eldritch Reaver, and speak to Lancelot again.
With Palamedes’ shield, clear the Tomb of Dagonet in the cliffs northeast of Cuanacht city, east of the round lake. Read the stone tablet near the end and leave by the door behind it.
Also with the shield, enter the Tomb of Sir Gawain beside the river west of Cuanacht city. Accept and complete Sir Bertilak’s challenge.
With Arthur’s Crown, clear the Tomb of Sir Galahad in eastern Forlorn Swords, above the settlement east of the northern river loop. Speak to Galahad and kill him.

Also with the crown, enter the Tomb of a Knight north of the giant sword monument in eastern Forlorn Swords. Accept Govannon’s Master’s Chisel quest, kill the Abandoned Warrior on the lower level, and return the quest item to Govannon.
At the final decision, choose “I want to use the Life Spindle”. Reload the Charred Conclave save if you already chose another ending.

achievements.description: Resolve the struggle for control of the Horns of the South.
achievements.summary: Resolve the struggle for control of the Horns of the South.

steps.text: Finish @mechanic{Shadow of the Horns}. Either faction earns this achievement; support Breandan to keep the Stonewarden route open.

achievements.description: Decide who receives the Menhir Rites Tablets.
achievements.summary: Decide who receives the Menhir Rites Tablets.

steps.text: During the Cuanacht main story, choose Denholm or Yvain as the recipient of the @item{Menhir Rites Tablets}.

achievements.description: Decide the fate of the giants.
achievements.summary: Decide the fate of the giants.

steps.text: Resolve the giants’ fate during the Forlorn Swords main story.

achievements.description: Return the 12 required Keeper tags to the Quartermaster.
achievements.summary: Return the 12 required Keeper tags to the Quartermaster.

guide.context: Pate’s tag is excluded from the required set. Deliver the twelve listed tags to the Quartermaster in the fortress.

collectibles.name: Ninian’s Tag
collectibles.method: Save before leaving the prologue. Take the laboratory key from the dead priest down the hall, grant Ninian’s request to die, and loot his tag.
collectibles.note: Keep the save until you have the tag. If you left without it, reload that save.

collectibles.name: Bandit-area tag
collectibles.method: Search the body beside the bandit.

collectibles.name: Kings’ Road tag
collectibles.location: Boulder below the Kings’ Road bridge
collectibles.method: Loot the body against the boulder.

collectibles.name: First Sunken Village tag
collectibles.method: Search the first tagged body in the village buildings.
collectibles.note: There are two tags in separate buildings; check both off.

collectibles.name: Second Sunken Village tag
collectibles.method: Find and loot the second Keeper body.

collectibles.name: Redcap-hut tag
collectibles.method: Search the hut for the tag.

collectibles.name: Flooded Mine exterior tag
collectibles.method: Loot the Keeper body outside the entrance.

collectibles.name: Flooded Mine underwater tag
collectibles.location: Below the small bridge just before the mine boss
collectibles.method: Dive underwater and search the body beneath the bridge.

collectibles.name: Lighthouse tag
collectibles.method: Search beside the doorway.

collectibles.name: Ravine tag
collectibles.method: Search the ravine for the Keeper body.

collectibles.name: Ancient Crypt tag
collectibles.location: Side tunnels of the crypt opposite the necromancer
collectibles.method: Search the side passages for the body.

collectibles.name: Beach-camp tag
collectibles.method: Search the camp for the tag.

achievements.description: Discuss the cause of the priestesses’ madness with Laurelia.
achievements.summary: Discuss the cause of the priestesses’ madness with Laurelia.

steps.text: After the main story reveals the mysterious figure behind the madness, speak with @npc{Laurelia}.

achievements.description: Defeat the Queen of Sagremor.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Queen of Sagremor.

steps.text: Defeat the @enemy{Queen of Sagremor} during the Cuanacht main story.

achievements.description: Complete the four Restoring Order assignments.
achievements.summary: Complete the four Restoring Order assignments.

steps.text: After the Keeper oath, finish @mechanic{Restoring Order: The Gallows}, the assignment @mechanic{Restoring Order: Little Grove}, the assignment @mechanic{Restoring Order: Kings’ Road} and the assignment @mechanic{Restoring Order: Merchant Ruins}. Kill the enemies marked by each assignment; each quest completes automatically.

achievements.description: Reach and speak to the Bleeding Heart beneath Cuanacht.
achievements.summary: Reach and speak to the Bleeding Heart beneath Cuanacht.

steps.text: After taking Excalibur, enter the hidden door at @loc{Archspire} in Horns of the South and exhaust the Weaver’s dialogue.
After taking Palamedes’ shield, open the hidden door in northwestern Cuanacht, north of the western lakes. Defeat the Fore-Dweller Knight and touch the glowing stone to obtain a memory shard.
Speak to the Weaver farther inside, then exhaust the @npc{Bleeding Heart}’s dialogue at the dungeon’s end.

achievements.description: Bring all four Dál Riata tribes to the Moot.
achievements.summary: Bring all four Dál Riata tribes to the Moot.

steps.text: Save before making tribal decisions in @mechanic{Divided We Fall}. Keep this save until the Moot; reload it if a tribe refuses to attend.
For Sveinn, finish The Trial and God’s Cure. During The Breach, speak to Barlaam before meeting the Stagfather, agree to kill the Stagfather, then report back after the fight.

For Theud, complete Easy Prey, Enter the Void, Flight Delayed and Doubt is a Lonely Place during The Sleep that Never Comes. When speaking to Mother, first choose the reply beginning “I want Yngvi to attend the Moot.” Then select the reply beginning “The Theud are needed in the waking world. Gerf’hanr…” Finally choose the reply beginning “Yngvi has fulfilled her duty to the tribe. Now she…”.
For Ulfr, finish Rise the Mountain, Face the Storm. After Thrygve dies, appoint @npc{Stron’ner} as leader.
For Volker, finish Mad Men, Shattered Pride, Follow Her Path and The Forked Path for Angsvar.
Take Arthur’s Crown, descend in the elevator, and leave through the entrance to meet the chiefs. Fast travel skips this trigger.

achievements.description: Deliver the Old Letter to Erfyr after helping Beor.
achievements.summary: Deliver the Old Letter to Erfyr after helping Beor.

steps.text: At the start of the prologue, retain a manual save. Take the @item{Guard’s Key} from the dead priest to the right of your cell. Open the cell to the left and take the @item{Old Letter} from its crate.
Read the letter to start @mechanic{Unforgettable}. Keep the opening save until you have the letter; reload it if you left without collecting the letter.
In Cuanacht, speak to @npc{Erfyr} and complete @mechanic{Change of Heart} for Beor. Speak to Erfyr again about the letter.

achievements.description: Secure the Merchants’ Union’s support for Ailei’s hospital.
achievements.summary: Secure the Merchants’ Union’s support for Ailei’s hospital.

steps.text: Save before accepting @npc{Ailei}’s hospital quests in Cuanacht. Keep this save through the final hospital visit so you can reload a failed conversation.

Start The Broken Hourglass and talk to Wilbur. Search his ruined home in the Plague-Stricken Zone for two letters and a teddy bear; one letter is on a table, the other on a post, and the bear is on the bedroom wardrobe.

Pretend to be Wilbur’s grandchild. Choose the answers about his gift when your father died, the flame warding man from beast, and brave Grandpa chasing the danger away. Ask him to accept treatment, then offer to find Ailei an investor.
Ask @npc{Alwyn} in the market to invest. Seek support from Bonxie, Erwin and Osmond. Save before Bonxie’s skill check and bring 2,000 coins for her purchase.
For Measured Mercy, bring Erwin 5 Daffodils, 3 Mandrakes, 3 Strawchild’s Skulls and 2 Fae’s Blood.
For Oh Merry Men, take Robbie’s bow from the reinforced chest beside a statue near the end of @loc{Swamp Crypt}. Return the bow to Osmond and ask him to support the investment.
Tell Alwyn everyone supports the hospital. Rest 24 hours, then visit Ailei and ask whether she needs anything else.

achievements.description: Take the oath to join the Keepers of the South.
achievements.summary: Take the oath to join the Keepers of the South.

steps.text: Save before the faction choices in @mechanic{Shadow of the Horns}. Support @npc{Captain Breandan} and kill Galahad.
When Breandan offers his secret, answer “I’m listening.” In Sewal’s Tomb, agree to help him convince Fearghas.
Finish the normal Excalibur story and take the Keeper oath. If you refused Breandan’s help request, reload the retained faction-choice save.

achievements.description: Finish the Children of Morrigan questline.
achievements.summary: Finish the Children of Morrigan questline.

steps.text: Save before freeing @npc{Vidar} from his cage; the key is in a nearby crate. Meet him at Roscree and permit his recruitment by the Children of Morrigan. Keep this save until the questline is complete.
For Luth’s No Place for Strays, recover the Highwayman’s @item{Bandit’s Journal} from the bandit watchtower. In The Killers of Reason, tell Hrolf he has been chosen as an informant.
During Cuckoo’s Egg, tell Abrin you came to kill him, then hear him out. Report to Luth and ask Self at @loc{Morrigan’s Hollow} for the next task.
For Hold Her Head High, take @item{Morrigan’s Head} from the Seer’s corpse in the quest cave, kill the Banshee, and return to Self.
In Wayward Son, speak to Vin and Denholm at their camp. Offer to clear the Family Crypt, read the stone at the middle sarcophagus, and tell Vin that Denholm is his father. Report back to Self.

For Sweet Dreams, cross the giant sword spanning the valley and enter the nest. Finish the dream quest; either Self or War can be chosen. If you refused the faction route or killed a quest NPC, reload the retained save.

achievements.description: Persuade the talking chicken to attempt flight.
achievements.summary: Persuade the talking chicken to attempt flight.

steps.text: Save before your first conversation with @npc{Jann Heber} in the fortress. Ask about the recipe he was whispering, offer to test it, then drink his potion. Reload if the offer disappears.
Use the scaffolding beside Eogan to reach the fortress chicken coop. Exhaust the white chicken’s dialogue.
In Cuanacht, find the chicken near the pig farmer and exhaust his dialogue again.

In Theud village, find him beside the crane at the broken bridge. Save, ask about his plans, suggest flying, and keep asking whether he has tried. Finish with “So just do it.” Reload this save if the conversation ends another way.

achievements.description: Complete a romance with Alisa or Beor.
achievements.summary: Complete a romance with Alisa or Beor.

steps.text: For Beor’s route, save before starting Erfyr’s @mechanic{Change of Heart} in Cuanacht. Complete the quest to recover Beor’s heart.

Rest 24 hours after Change of Heart, then speak to Beor for @mechanic{The Heart that Defies}. Supply Kvorr’s materials and give your own life energy to the replacement heart. Keep the save until the romance unlocks; reload if you refuse the life-energy choice.

After delivering the replacement heart to Beor, rest another 24 hours and speak to him for @mechanic{Stitch by Stitch}. collect Black Alder, Family Iron and Whispering Crystal at the quest markers and return each delivery.
Choose the affectionate dialogue with Beor and accept his feelings at the end.

achievements.description: Let the Fungal Envoy take root in King Sagremor.
achievements.summary: Let the Fungal Envoy take root in King Sagremor.

steps.text: Save during @mechanic{Throne of the Depths}, before using the Custodian’s chapel keys. Keep this save until you have spoken to the king.
Speak to the mycelium in the first room after the locked door. Answer “Yes, show me.” and “I will do it.”
When speaking to King Sagremor, choose “The Fungal Envoy will give a new life to this place.” Reload the saved branch if you refused the envoy or chose another outcome.

achievements.description: Finish the Alchemist Guild questline.
achievements.summary: Finish the Alchemist Guild questline.

steps.text: Save before accepting Taranis’ collaboration in @loc{Mistbearer’s Den}. Keep saves before each later guild decision until you finish the chain; reload if you refuse a task or lose a quest NPC.

For Whispers in the Dark, touch the shrine, kill the Mistbearer, and give Taranis its remains. For Behind the Curtain Waits a Darker World, take Journal Vol. I beside the bed and Vol. II beside the desk in Eckhart’s Cave; return to Taranis.

During Over My Dead Bodies, take @item{Caelum’s Journal} from his bookshelf. Reading without taking it can block the quest. Speak to the basement plant, then touch the flower at Beast Lair’s end and defeat the Gloomfrond. Return to Taranis.
At Phaidros’ Lab, accept The Price of Perfection. Make a deal with Foxglove during Fragments of Humanity, then return to the lab and agree to help Alma.

For Aberrant Minds, bring Alma a Wyrd Changed Brain, Nuckelavee’s Brain and Red Death Infected Brain from the marked areas. During Misgivings, pay Skvor at the exchange instead of starting a fight, then ask Alma for more work.
Find Dolf in Forlorn Swords and accept Unfolding. Deliver his requested snail slime for Extinction of the Weak, refuse his experiment with “You’re completely insane.”, and obtain his report for Alma.

Return to Alma for Providence, then visit Heledd’s Sanctum for The Baneful Choir. Cross the floating tiles, discuss her substitute for sacrifices, and touch the Effigy. Agree to kill the Effigy, defeat it, and speak to Heledd again.

achievements.description: Finish the Stonewarden questline.
achievements.summary: Finish the Stonewarden questline.

steps.text: Before resolving Shadow of the Horns, save and support Breandan rather than Galahad. Keep this save through Ughwe’s introduction; reload if the opposing branch kills the NPC needed for this questline.

At the All-Mother’s Temple, ask @npc{Ughwe} to teach you during Echoes in Stone. At a grindstone, make a Rough-Hewn Relic with Wyrdstone and 5 Ethereal Cobwebs, then return to him. Kill nighttime Wyrdspawns where humanoids died during the day for cobwebs.

Meet Kvorr in Cuanacht and accept the rescue in Crystal Cave. At the cave’s bottom, speak to the boy, mine the rock beside him with a pickaxe, and defeat the Frostbitten Warriors. Speak to the boy outside and return to Kvorr.
At a grindstone, make the Stonewarden Talisman from 3 Meteorite Ore, 3 Wyrdstone and 25 Ethereal Cobwebs.
Meet Darv’hanr in Forlorn Swords. During Call of the Wintermoon, inspect the bottom of Old Wyrdstone Mine and report back.

For Heart Turns to Stone, speak to Fusca, then Frost in Cave by the Cliff. Brew Potion of Olf from 1 Spirits, 2 Frost Shards and 5 Peppermint. Give the potion to Olf, then return to Fusca and Darv’hanr.
Clear Stonewarden’s Hearth for Forge Extinguished. For Immoral and Divine, use the quest pedestal, enter the Frozen Realm and defeat Cailleach.

In Conquered Scars, speak to Darv’hanr in Stonewarden’s Vault, decide the prisoners’ fate, and speak to him again. Either prisoner decision works. Save before later quest conversations so refusals or NPC deaths can be undone.

achievements.description: Kill Caradoc on Asylum Island.
achievements.summary: Kill Caradoc on Asylum Island.

steps.text: Make a manual save before leaving the prologue beach with @npc{Caradoc}. Keep that save until you have killed him and taken his armor.
Fight Caradoc and use the execution prompt when his health reaches zero. Story difficulty makes the fight easier.
Loot his Ranger’s Hood, Gauntlets, Cuirass, Greaves and Boots for Double Identity.

achievements.description: Extract Excalibur before receiving the Keepers’ ritual assistance.
achievements.summary: Extract Excalibur before receiving the Keepers’ ritual assistance.

steps.text: During @mechanic{A World to Win}, save before fixing the gong and performing the ritual. Keep this save for the normal story route.
Bring 10 @item{Beef Stew} and 10 @item{Hunter’s Stew} from Ron’s Tavern, or strong healing consumables. Fill your @mechanic{King’s Soul} bar.
At Excalibur, consume the food rapidly, activate King’s Soul to slow time, then hold the extraction button through the health drain.
Reload the saved game after the unlock. Finish the ritual normally so the Keeper oath and Restoring Order quests remain available.

achievements.description: Reach Fearghas inside the fortress without opening the main gate.
achievements.summary: Reach Fearghas inside the fortress without opening the main gate.

steps.text: Save before talking to @npc{Odran} at the fortress gate. Swim around the gate route into the settlement, then speak to @npc{Fearghas}. If Odran has opened the gate, reload this save.

achievements.description: Reach level 5.
achievements.summary: Raise your character to level 5.

steps.text: Earn experience through quests and combat until your character reaches @mechanic{level 5}.

achievements.description: Reach level 20.
achievements.summary: Raise your character to level 20.

steps.text: Earn experience through quests and combat until your character reaches @mechanic{level 20}.

achievements.description: Reach level 35.
achievements.summary: Raise your character to level 35.

steps.text: Earn experience through quests and combat until your character reaches @mechanic{level 35}.

achievements.description: Reach level 50.
achievements.summary: Raise your character to level 50.

steps.text: Earn experience through quests and combat until your character reaches @mechanic{level 50}.

achievements.description: Buy a property.
achievements.summary: Purchase a home.

steps.text: Buy the @loc{Wooden Villa} in Horns of the South for 20,000 coins. A home received for free does not count.

achievements.description: Craft 10 items.
achievements.summary: Make 10 items through crafting.

steps.text: Buy 10 @item{Iron Ore} from Osbryht at the fortress forge and craft lockpicks at his grindstone.

achievements.description: Cook 50 dishes.
achievements.summary: Prepare 50 dishes.

steps.text: Buy cooking ingredients from Ruairc in the fortress Kitchen. Use your bonfire’s cooking menu to prepare 50 dishes.

achievements.description: Brew 25 potions.
achievements.summary: Produce 25 potions through alchemy.

steps.text: Buy @item{With the Alembif Among the Tribes: The Picts} from Jann Heber to learn the Small Health Potion recipe.
At the station inside Jann’s quarters, brew 25 Small Health Potions with a total of 25 Spirits and 50 Sage. Buy ingredients from Jann and rest between batches when he needs to restock.

achievements.description: Amass a wealth of 10,000.
achievements.summary: Hold 10,000 coins at one time.

steps.text: Save your coins until your current balance reaches 10,000. Sell unwanted loot rather than spending the money as you earn it.

achievements.description: Catch all fish species in Avalon.
achievements.summary: Obtain all 35 fish species found in Avalon.

steps.text: Visit @npc{Malcolm} on the beach north of @loc{The Village} in Horns of the South. Buy each fish species you are missing; purchased fish count alongside catches.

achievements.description: Visit all the main regions of Avalon.
achievements.summary: Visit Horns of the South, Cuanacht and Forlorn Swords.

steps.text: Follow the main story into @loc{Forlorn Swords} after completing Horns of the South and Cuanacht.

achievements.description: Lockpick 50 locks.
achievements.summary: Open 50 locks by lockpicking.

steps.text: Pick locked doors and chests as you explore until you have opened 50 locks. Make more lockpicks at a grindstone when needed.

achievements.description: Unlock 25 journal entries.
achievements.summary: Add 25 entries to your journal.

steps.text: Explore new places and progress quests until your journal contains 25 discovered entries.

achievements.description: Cultivate a plant.
achievements.summary: Grow and harvest a plant.

steps.text: Save before starting Eogan’s @mechanic{Roots of Knowledge} in the fortress. Speak to Ruairc about Eogan, then return to Eogan for his Special Seeds.
Plant the seeds in the planters beside Eogan. Rest 36 hours, harvest the plants, and speak to him again. If you refused the quest or killed Eogan, reload the retained save.

achievements.description: Get ambushed during Wyrdnight.
achievements.summary: Be attacked during a Wyrdnight camp ambush.

steps.text: Place a bonfire near @loc{Petrified Visage} and rest into Wyrdnight. After “Something’s lurking in the dark”, let the nearby enemies attack you; waking to the warning alone is insufficient.

achievements.description: Visit every sacred site where the Stagfather’s presence lingers.
achievements.summary: Complete the trials at all nine Stagfather shrines.

guide.context: Each trial gives you 20 seconds to kill three Wyrddeer. Save before activating a shrine; after a failed attempt, reload or rest 24 hours to retry.

collectibles.name: Western plains
collectibles.method: Activate the shrine, kill the three Wyrddeer before time runs out, then use the shrine again to claim the reward.

collectibles.name: Northeastern river
collectibles.method: Activate the shrine, kill the three Wyrddeer before time runs out, then use the shrine again to claim the reward.

collectibles.name: Eastern plateau
collectibles.location: Inland plateau north of the coastal ruins
collectibles.method: Activate the shrine, kill the three Wyrddeer before time runs out, then use the shrine again to claim the reward.

collectibles.name: Northwestern lake
collectibles.location: North bank of the western lake
collectibles.method: Activate the shrine, kill the three Wyrddeer before time runs out, then use the shrine again to claim the reward.

collectibles.name: Northeastern lake
collectibles.location: Northeast of the circular northern lake
collectibles.method: Activate the shrine, kill the three Wyrddeer before time runs out, then use the shrine again to claim the reward.

collectibles.name: Southwestern hills
collectibles.location: Hills southwest of the city, beyond the river
collectibles.method: Activate the shrine, kill the three Wyrddeer before time runs out, then use the shrine again to claim the reward.

collectibles.name: Northwestern coast
collectibles.location: Coast north of the western settlement
collectibles.method: Activate the shrine, kill the three Wyrddeer before time runs out, then use the shrine again to claim the reward.

collectibles.name: Northeastern coast
collectibles.location: Coast north of the eastern settlement
collectibles.method: Activate the shrine, kill the three Wyrddeer before time runs out, then use the shrine again to claim the reward.

collectibles.name: Southwestern plateau
collectibles.location: Plateau west of the central green valley
collectibles.method: Activate the shrine, kill the three Wyrddeer before time runs out, then use the shrine again to claim the reward.

achievements.description: Max out a single Skill Proficiency.
achievements.summary: Reach the maximum level in one Skill Proficiency.

steps.text: Keep using your main weapon type, or keep cooking, until that @mechanic{Skill Proficiency} reaches its maximum.

achievements.description: Kill 5 enemies with a single use of Arthur's Power.
achievements.summary: Defeat five enemies during one activation of Arthur’s Power.

steps.text: Gather five enemies and weaken them. Activate @mechanic{Arthur’s Power}, then finish all five before the effect ends.

achievements.description: Pet a sleeping Croakmaw.
achievements.summary: Pet a sleeping Croakmaw.

steps.text: Make a manual save before approaching a sleeping @enemy{Croakmaw} in the western hills of Cuanacht, west of the giant ribcage landmark. Pet the creature, then reload after the unlock to restore your arm. If you killed the sleeper first, reload that same save.

achievements.description: Die from a fall while wearing the Ring of Fall Damage Reduction.
achievements.summary: Die from a fall while wearing the Ring of Fall Damage Reduction.

steps.text: Take the corpse’s @item{Ring of Fall Damage Reduction} on the cliffside corpse northeast of the fortress, north of the village. Save before selling the ring or attempting the jump; equip it, jump from the cliff behind the corpse, then reload after the fatal fall.

achievements.description: Deliver an enemy’s killing blow with a sketchbook.
achievements.summary: Deliver an enemy’s killing blow with a sketchbook.

steps.text: Buy a @item{Sketchbook} from Orlaith in the fortress and select it on the left of the quick-use wheel. Weaken an enemy with your usual weapon, then finish the enemy with the sketchbook.

achievements.description: Become the Tired Guard’s best friend.
achievements.summary: Become the Tired Guard’s best friend.

steps.text: Save before meeting the @npc{Tired Guard} at the entrance to @loc{Smuggler’s Bay Caves}. Keep him alive; reload if the conversation fails or you kill him.
Ask about entry, say you have business with Arnulf, then ask to buy bloom: one sack for personal use.
Speak to the guard again, offer company, and agree to smoke. Ask about food, tomatoes and his job, then choose “Best friend?”.

achievements.description: Deliver the killing blow to Scourge of the Seas with a fishing rod.
achievements.summary: Deliver the killing blow to Scourge of the Seas with a fishing rod.

steps.text: Buy a @item{Fishing Rod} from Orlaith. Save before fighting @enemy{Scourge of the Seas} at the end of @loc{Castaways’ Cove}, below the All-Mother’s Temple.
Weaken the boss with your usual weapon, then equip the rod for the final hit. If another attack kills the boss, reload the save; the boss does not respawn.

achievements.description: Defeat Abigor, Beherit and Cobalt.
achievements.summary: Defeat Abigor, Beherit and Cobalt.

steps.text: Challenge or attack @enemy{Abigor} on the road south of the village, east of the fortress in Horns of the South.
Defeat @enemy{Beherit} on the path northeast of Cuanacht city, north of the round lake.
Defeat @enemy{Cobalt} in @loc{A Clean, Well-Lighted Place}, by the eastern Forlorn Swords settlement beside the giant sword monument.

achievements.description: Hatch Qrko from the Questing Beast Egg.
achievements.summary: Hatch Qrko from the Questing Beast Egg.

steps.text: Take the @item{Questing Beast Egg} from the far end of @loc{Lair of the Beast}.
Carry the egg for 5,000 steps, then rest at a bonfire to hatch Qrko. Check the egg’s tooltip for your step count.

achievements.description: Set a Strawfather on fire.
achievements.summary: Set a Strawfather on fire.

steps.text: At the wheat fields near @loc{Cuanacht Farm}, burn a @enemy{Strawfather} with a fire spell, fire arrow or torch. Alwyn sells a torch if you need one.

achievements.description: Awaken the Gloomfrond in Beast Lair.
achievements.summary: Awaken the Gloomfrond in Beast Lair.

steps.text: Complete Taranis’ Whispers in the Dark and Behind the Curtain Waits a Darker World to reach Over My Dead Bodies.

Take Caelum’s Journal and speak to the plant in his basement. Save before touching the flower at the end of @loc{Beast Lair}, then touch the flower to awaken the Gloomfrond. Keep this save until the unlock and reload if you resolve the encounter without it.

achievements.displayName: My Wolves Are Better Than Yours
achievements.description: Defeat 10 wolves using summoned wolves.
achievements.summary: Have summoned wolves kill 10 wild wolves.

steps.text: Find @item{Wolf’s Call} in @loc{Miners’ Tunnels}: descend to the small patch of water and open the small chest beyond it.
Summon wolves when fighting wild wolves. Weaken the wild wolves yourself if needed, but let your summons land the final blows on 10 wolves.

achievements.description: Find all books about Liliana.
achievements.summary: Carry all seven Beautiful Liliana books in your inventory.

guide.context: All seven books must be in your inventory together; stash storage does not count. Visit Vrell’s Bookstore in Cuanacht. Save before stealing and reload after the unlock if you want to undo the crime.

collectibles.name: Beautiful Liliana in the Dal Riata Captivity
collectibles.method: Buy this volume from Vrell.

collectibles.name: Beautiful Liliana in the Chamber of Ecstasy
collectibles.method: Buy this volume from Vrell.

collectibles.name: Beautiful Liliana and the Lustful Marquise
collectibles.method: Buy this volume from Vrell.

collectibles.name: Beautiful Liliana and the Lustful Marquise. Vol 2
collectibles.method: Buy this volume from Vrell.

collectibles.name: Beautiful Liliana and the Forbidden Pleasure
collectibles.method: Buy this volume from Vrell.

collectibles.name: Beautiful Liliana in the Dungeons of Perversion
collectibles.method: Steal this volume.

collectibles.name: Beautiful Liliana Returns to the Chamber of Ecstasy
collectibles.method: Steal this volume.

achievements.description: Speak to Caradoc for the first time in Act 1 while wearing his complete Ranger armor set.
achievements.summary: Speak to Caradoc for the first time in Act 1 while wearing his complete Ranger armor set.

steps.text: Before leaving Asylum Island, kill Caradoc and take his @item{Ranger’s Hood}, @item{Ranger’s Gauntlets}, @item{Ranger’s Cuirass}, @item{Ranger’s Greaves} and @item{Ranger’s Boots}.
Save before speaking to Caradoc outside @loc{Lair of the Beast} in Act 1. Equip the five armor pieces, then talk to him. Reload this save if you spoke without the full set.

achievements.description: Turn Rumpolt into cheese with Rumpolt’s Revenge.
achievements.summary: Turn Rumpolt into cheese with Rumpolt’s Revenge.

steps.text: Save before accepting Orlaith’s @mechanic{The Silk Road}. Find Nest, recover the package, and return it to Orlaith. Follow her instructions to plant it by @loc{Broch Prison} after clearing the Ogre. Detonate it with a ranged attack.

Enter and speak to Rumpolt to begin @mechanic{120 Days of Herring and Cheese}. Catch the Really Special Herring at the quest’s fishing spot. Buy Cheese from Ruairc and cook @item{Sour Herring and Cheese} at a bonfire.
Deliver the dish to Rumpolt for @item{Rumpolt’s Revenge}, then cast the spell on him. Keep your quest save until the unlock; reload if you refused the quest or killed Rumpolt.

achievements.description: Kill a bear using fists.
achievements.summary: Deliver a bear’s killing blow with bare fists.

steps.text: Weaken a @enemy{Bear} with your usual weapon, unequip your weapon, then land the final hit with your fists.

achievements.description: Hit an enemy's weakspot 100 times.
achievements.summary: Land 100 hits on enemy weak spots.

steps.text: Use a bow to score headshots. If ordinary hits do not register, save before attacking @npc{Margh} at the small house below the cliff north of the fortress, west of the village in Horns of the South. Shoot his head until the counter reaches 100 without executing him, then reload to undo the attack.

achievements.description: Arrive in the Sanctuary of Sarras.
achievements.summary: Arrive in the Sanctuary of Sarras.

steps.text: In Act 2 or 3, place a bonfire in Cuanacht or Forlorn Swords. Speak to @npc{The Lost One} to begin @mechanic{The Descent}.
Follow the quest marker through @loc{Sarras Chapel} and use the boat at the dock to reach Sarras.

achievements.description: Awaken Sarras by sounding the Carnyx.
achievements.summary: Awaken Sarras by sounding the Carnyx.

steps.text: Progress the Sarras story and sound the @item{Carnyx} when the quest directs you to use it.

achievements.description: Gather the three Organists in Sarras.
achievements.summary: Gather the three Organists in Sarras.

steps.text: Complete the Sarras main-story objectives that bring the three @npc{Organists} together.

achievements.description: Resolve the fate of the underwater kingdom of Sarras.
achievements.summary: Resolve the fate of the underwater kingdom of Sarras.

steps.text: Make a manual save before the final Sarras decision. Finish the Golden Floatling task before making that decision, then complete the DLC story; its ending closes access to Sarras.

achievements.description: Kill and loot the Golden Floatling.
achievements.summary: Kill and loot the Golden Floatling.

steps.text: Before ending the Sarras story, speak to @npc{Vosk} at @loc{Island In-Between} for @mechanic{The Wandering Miracle}. Return four Red Floatling Flesh from Chapter House, Observatory, Carcass of the Great Serpent and The Oozing Fields.
After that quest, enter @loc{The Ulcerate} on the northwestern island. Pass the first right-hand turn and take the second. Take the next right, then drop down the ledge and turn right again.
Kill the @enemy{Golden Floatling} near the chest and two Finbleds, then loot its body. If you already ended Sarras, reload your save from before the final decision to regain access.
